content.json:
# Azure Compute Capacity
Latest deployed vCPU inventory across the management-group scope. Capacity views aggregate deployed vCPUs by subscription and VM family because Azure Compute quota is enforced at the family level.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query: resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project value=subscriptionId, label=name | order by label asc

parameters.name: Region
parameters.label: Region
parameters.query: let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s); ComputeCapacity_CL | where CollectionId_s == latestCollection | extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey | distinct Region_s | order by Region_s asc | project value=Region_s, label=Region_s

parameters.name: Family
parameters.label: VM Family
parameters.query: let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s); ComputeCapacity_CL | where CollectionId_s == latestCollection | extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey | where isnotempty(VmFamily_s) | distinct VmFamily_s | order by VmFamily_s asc | project value=VmFamily_s, label=VmFamily_s

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend AdvisorProperties=parse_json(properties)
| extend Category=tostring(AdvisorProperties.category),
         RecommendationSubcategory=tostring(AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties.recommendationSubCategory),
         RecommendationStatus=tostring(AdvisorProperties.recommendationStatus),
         ImpactedField=tolower(tostring(AdvisorProperties.impactedField)),
         ImpactedResource=coalesce(tostring(AdvisorProperties.resourceMetadata.resourceId), tostring(AdvisorProperties.resourceMetadata.ResourceId)),
         RetirementDateText=tostring(AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties.retirementDate),
         RetiringFeature=tostring(AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties.retirementFeatureName),
         Recommendation=tostring(AdvisorProperties.shortDescription.problem),
         RecommendedAction=tostring(AdvisorProperties.shortDescription.solution),
         Impact=tostring(AdvisorProperties.impact),
         LastUpdated=todatetime(AdvisorProperties.lastUpdated),
         ExtendedProperties=AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties
| where isempty(RecommendationStatus) or RecommendationStatus in~ ('New', 'InProgress')
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or subscriptionId in ({Subscription})
| extend ResourceJoinId=tolower(ImpactedResource)
| where ImpactedField in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets')
    or ResourceJoinId contains '/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/'
    or ResourceJoinId contains '/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets/'
| extend AdvisorCurrentSku=tostring(coalesce(ExtendedProperties.currentSku, ExtendedProperties.CurrentSku, ExtendedProperties.fromSku, ExtendedProperties.FromSku)),
         TargetSku=tostring(coalesce(ExtendedProperties.targetSku, ExtendedProperties.TargetSku, ExtendedProperties.toSku, ExtendedProperties.ToSku, ExtendedProperties.recommendedSku, ExtendedProperties.RecommendedSku)),
         AnnualSavings=todouble(coalesce(ExtendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount, ExtendedProperties.AnnualSavingsAmount)),
         SavingsCurrency=tostring(coalesce(ExtendedProperties.savingsCurrency, ExtendedProperties.SavingsCurrency))
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets')
    | extend ResourceJoinId=tolower(id), ResourceCurrentSku=iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), tostring(sku.name))
    | project ResourceJoinId, ResourceCurrentSku
) on ResourceJoinId
| extend CurrentSku=iff(isempty(AdvisorCurrentSku), ResourceCurrentSku, AdvisorCurrentSku),
         LifecycleText=strcat(RetiringFeature, ' ', Recommendation, ' ', RecommendedAction),
         UpgradeText=strcat(Recommendation, ' ', RecommendedAction),
         RetirementDate=todatetime(RetirementDateText)
| extend CurrentGeneration=toint(extract(@'(?i)v(\d+)$', 1, CurrentSku)),
         TargetGeneration=toint(extract(@'(?i)v(\d+)$', 1, TargetSku))
| extend IsSkuLifecycle=Category =~ 'HighAvailability'
            and RecommendationSubcategory =~ 'ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement'
            and isnotnull(RetirementDate)
            and RetirementDate > now()
            and LifecycleText matches regex @'(?i)(sku|vm size|virtual machine size|series|family)',
         IsSkuUpgradeCost=Category =~ 'Cost'
            and isnotempty(TargetSku)
            and isnotnull(CurrentGeneration)
            and isnotnull(TargetGeneration)
            and TargetGeneration > CurrentGeneration
            and UpgradeText matches regex @'(?i)(upgrad|migrat|moderniz|newer.*(sku|vm size|series)|latest.*(sku|vm size|series))'
                    and not(UpgradeText matches regex @'(?i)(right.?siz|resiz|shut.?down|underutiliz)')
| where IsSkuLifecycle or IsSkuUpgradeCost
| extend RecommendationType=iff(IsSkuLifecycle, 'Upcoming VM SKU retirement', 'VM SKU upgrade cost saving')
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName=name
) on subscriptionId
| project ['Recommendation type']=RecommendationType, Subscription=iff(isempty(SubscriptionName), subscriptionId, SubscriptionName), ['Resource group']=resourceGroup, ['Impacted resource']=ImpactedResource, Impact, ['Current SKU']=CurrentSku, ['Recommended SKU']=TargetSku, Recommendation, ['Recommended action']=RecommendedAction, ['Retiring feature']=RetiringFeature, ['Retirement date']=RetirementDate, ['Annual savings']=AnnualSavings, Currency=SavingsCurrency, Status=RecommendationStatus, ['Last updated']=LastUpdated
| order by ['Recommendation type'] asc, ['Retirement date'] asc nulls last, ['Annual savings'] desc nulls last, Subscription asc
content.title: Advisor - upcoming VM SKU retirements and SKU upgrade cost recommendations
content.noDataMessage: No upcoming VM SKU retirements or explicit VM SKU upgrade cost recommendations were found for the selected subscriptions.

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family})
| where tolong(DeployedInstances_d) > 0
| extend RestrictionDetail=strcat(ComputeSku_s, ': ', coalesce(SkuRestrictions_s, 'Unknown')),
         ZoneDetail=strcat(ComputeSku_s, ': ', coalesce(AvailabilityZones_s, 'Unknown'))
| summarize ['Deployed instances']=sum(tolong(DeployedInstances_d)), SkuSizes=make_set(ComputeSku_s, 100), SkuRestrictions=make_set(RestrictionDetail, 100), AvailabilityZones=make_set(ZoneDetail, 100), ['Quota used']=take_any(tolong(QuotaUsageVCpus_d)), ['Quota limit']=take_any(tolong(QuotaLimitVCpus_d)), Generation=max(tolong(SkuGeneration_d)), ['Newest generation']=max(tolong(LatestGeneration_d)), ['Generation gap']=max(tolong(GenerationLag_d)) by Subscription=SubscriptionName_s, Region=Region_s, Family=VmFamily_s
| extend ['Generation age']=case(isnull(Generation) or isnull(['Newest generation']), 'Not versioned', ['Generation gap'] == 0, 'N', ['Generation gap'] >= 4, 'N-4+', strcat('N-', ['Generation gap'])),
         ['SKU sizes']=strcat_array(array_sort_asc(SkuSizes), ', '),
         ['SKU restrictions']=strcat_array(array_sort_asc(SkuRestrictions), '; '),
         ['Availability zones']=strcat_array(array_sort_asc(AvailabilityZones), '; '),
                 ['Quota usage']=iff(isnull(['Quota used']) or isnull(['Quota limit']) or ['Quota limit'] <= 0, 'Unavailable', strcat(['Quota used'], ' / ', ['Quota limit'], ' vCPUs (', round(100.0 * todouble(['Quota used']) / ['Quota limit'], 1), '%)'))
| extend ['SKU family']=iff(['Generation age'] == 'Not versioned', Family, strcat(['Generation age'], ' | ', Family))
| project Subscription, Region, ['SKU family'], ['SKU sizes'], ['Deployed instances'], ['Quota usage'], ['SKU restrictions'], ['Availability zones'], Generation, ['Newest generation'], ['Generation gap']
| order by Subscription asc, Region asc, ['Generation gap'] desc, ['SKU family'] asc
content.title: Deployed VM SKU families, quota, restrictions, and zones
content.noDataMessage: No deployed VM SKU families were found for the selected filters.

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
let capacity = ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey;
let scoped = capacity
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family});
let totalInstances = toscalar(scoped | summarize sum(tolong(DeployedInstances_d)));
scoped
| summarize ['VM instances']=sum(tolong(DeployedInstances_d)) by Subscription=SubscriptionName_s, Region=Region_s
| extend ['Deployment share']=iff(totalInstances > 0, todouble(['VM instances']) / totalInstances, 0.0)
| order by ['Deployment share'] desc, Subscription asc, Region asc
content.title: Deployment concentration heat map - percentage of VM instances by subscription and region
content.noDataMessage: No deployed compute was found for the selected subscriptions and regions.

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
let capacity = ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey;
let scoped = capacity
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family});
union
(scoped | summarize Value=sum(tolong(DeployedVCpus_d)) by SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, Region_s | extend RegionalMetric=strcat(Region_s, ' - Deployed vCPUs')),
(scoped | summarize Value=take_any(tolong(QuotaLimitVCpus_d)) by SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, Region_s | extend RegionalMetric=strcat(Region_s, ' - VM-family quota')),
(scoped | summarize Value=take_any(tolong(QuotaAvailableVCpus_d)) by SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, Region_s | extend RegionalMetric=strcat(Region_s, ' - Available quota gap'))
| project SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, RegionalMetric, Value
| evaluate pivot(RegionalMetric, take_any(Value), SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s)
| order by SubscriptionName_s asc, VmFamily_s asc
content.title: VM family by region matrix - deployed vCPUs, quota, and available gap

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family})
| summarize ['Deployed vCPUs']=sum(tolong(DeployedVCpus_d)), ['Reserved vCPUs']=take_any(tolong(ReservedVCpus_d)) by Subscription=SubscriptionName_s, Region=Region_s, Family=VmFamily_s
| where ['Reserved vCPUs'] > 0
| extend ['Unused reserved vCPUs']=iff(['Reserved vCPUs'] > ['Deployed vCPUs'], ['Reserved vCPUs'] - ['Deployed vCPUs'], 0),
         ['Reservation coverage']=iff(['Deployed vCPUs'] > 0, todouble(min_of(['Reserved vCPUs'], ['Deployed vCPUs'])) / ['Deployed vCPUs'], real(null)),
         ['Reservation status']=case(['Reserved vCPUs'] > ['Deployed vCPUs'], 'Underutilized reservation', ['Reserved vCPUs'] < ['Deployed vCPUs'], 'Reservation gap - SLA risk', 'Fully matched')
| project Subscription, Region, Family, ['Reservation status'], ['Deployed vCPUs'], ['Reserved vCPUs'], ['Unused reserved vCPUs'], ['Reservation coverage']
| order by ['Unused reserved vCPUs'] desc, Subscription asc, Region asc

content.noDataMessage: No capacity reservations were found for the selected filters.

content.query:
let dailyCollections = ComputeCapacityRuns_CL
| where Status_s == 'Completed'
| summarize CompletedAt=max(CompletedAt_t) by CollectionId_s
| extend Day=bin(CompletedAt, 1d)
| summarize arg_max(CompletedAt, CollectionId_s) by Day;
let daily = ComputeCapacity_CL
| join kind=inner dailyCollections on CollectionId_s
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CollectionId_s, DedupKey
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family})
| summarize ['Deployed vCPUs']=sum(tolong(DeployedVCpus_d)), ['Quota limit']=take_any(tolong(QuotaLimitVCpus_d)) by Day, SubscriptionName_s, Region_s, VmFamily_s;
daily
| summarize ['Deployed vCPUs']=sum(['Deployed vCPUs']), ['Quota limit']=sum(['Quota limit']) by Day
| project CompletedAt=Day, ['Deployed vCPUs'], ['Quota limit']
| order by CompletedAt asc
content.title: Deployed vCPU and quota limit trend (last 30 daily collections) - for growth forecasting
content.noDataMessage: No completed collections were found in the retained 30-day history for the selected filters.

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
let scoped = ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family})
| where tolong(DeployedInstances_d) > 0
| extend ['Generation age']=case(isnull(toint(SkuGeneration_d)) or isnull(toint(LatestGeneration_d)), 'Not versioned', tolong(GenerationLag_d) == 0, 'N (current)', tolong(GenerationLag_d) >= 4, 'N-4+', strcat('N-', tolong(GenerationLag_d)));
let totals = scoped
| summarize ['Total vCPUs']=sum(tolong(DeployedVCpus_d)) by Subscription=SubscriptionName_s;
scoped

| join kind=inner totals on Subscription
| extend ['Share of vCPUs']=iff(['Total vCPUs'] > 0, todouble(['Deployed vCPUs']) / ['Total vCPUs'], 0.0)
| project Subscription, ['Generation age'], ['Deployed vCPUs'], ['Share of vCPUs'], ['Total vCPUs']

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| extend AdvisorProperties=parse_json(properties)
| extend Category=tostring(AdvisorProperties.category),
         RecommendationSubcategory=tostring(AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties.recommendationSubCategory),
         RecommendationStatus=tostring(AdvisorProperties.recommendationStatus),
         ImpactedField=tolower(tostring(AdvisorProperties.impactedField)),
         ImpactedResource=coalesce(tostring(AdvisorProperties.resourceMetadata.resourceId), tostring(AdvisorProperties.resourceMetadata.ResourceId)),
         RetirementDateText=tostring(AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties.retirementDate),
         RetiringFeature=tostring(AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties.retirementFeatureName),
         Recommendation=tostring(AdvisorProperties.shortDescription.problem),
         RecommendedAction=tostring(AdvisorProperties.shortDescription.solution),
         ExtendedProperties=AdvisorProperties.extendedProperties
| where isempty(RecommendationStatus) or RecommendationStatus in~ ('New', 'InProgress')
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or subscriptionId in ({Subscription})
| where ImpactedField in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets')
| extend AdvisorCurrentSku=tostring(coalesce(ExtendedProperties.currentSku, ExtendedProperties.CurrentSku, ExtendedProperties.fromSku, ExtendedProperties.FromSku)),
         LifecycleText=strcat(RetiringFeature, ' ', Recommendation, ' ', RecommendedAction),
         RetirementDate=todatetime(RetirementDateText)
| where Category =~ 'HighAvailability'
    and RecommendationSubcategory =~ 'ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement'
    and isnotnull(RetirementDate)
    and RetirementDate > now()
    and LifecycleText matches regex @'(?i)(sku|vm size|virtual machine size|series|family)'
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName=name
) on subscriptionId
| summarize ['Impacted resources']=dcount(ImpactedResource), ['Current SKUs']=make_set(AdvisorCurrentSku, 50) by Subscription=iff(isempty(SubscriptionName), subscriptionId, SubscriptionName), ['Retiring feature']=RetiringFeature, ['Retirement date']=RetirementDate
| extend ['Days until retirement']=datetime_diff('day', ['Retirement date'], now()),
         ['Current SKUs']=strcat_array(array_sort_asc(['Current SKUs']), ', ')
| project Subscription, ['Retiring feature'], ['Current SKUs'], ['Impacted resources'], ['Retirement date'], ['Days until retirement']
| order by ['Retirement date'] asc, Subscription asc
